name: get_component_type
title: Get Component Type
description: Documentation for a component type by name - its class name, display title, description, group, and every inspector property with title, description, type and read-only state. Matches exact names first, then substrings; multiple substring matches come back as a candidate list.

name.description: The component's type name, e.g. 'ModelRenderer'. Case insensitive, substrings work.
